children: Transocean Ltd. (RIG) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 15, 2026.

("Transocean") today announced that the Deepwater Conqueror was awarded a two-well contract for work in Equatorial Guinea with an undisclosed operator. The estimated 170-day campaign is expected to commence in 2027 in direct continuation of the rig's current contract in the U.S Gulf and contribute approximately $80 million in backlog, excluding additional services and compensation for mobilization and demobilization.
A copy of the press release announcing the fixture referred to above is attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference as Exhibit 99.1.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1451505/000145150526000068/rig-20260915x8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1451505/000145150526000068/0001451505-26-000068-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
